log: As v474.05 does (OpenCivOne decompile, Segment_1ade.cs F0_1ade_1d2e): discovering Gunpowder, and again Combustion, destroys every Barracks in the discovering player's cities, with no refund, and emits `city-improvement:obsolete` (player, advance, Barracks, removed). The event fires even when there were none to remove, because the original tells the player every time.
The Barracks upkeep stand-in already had v474.05's 0/1/2 figures, but switched to 2 at Automobile. It now switches at Combustion (CityWorker.cs ~L3828-3845).

As v474.05: the production menu offers a Hydro Plant only when one of the eight squares around the city (not the city's own square) is River or Mountains (OpenCivOne decompile, Overlay_20.cs F20_0000_0000 sets the city flag; Segment_1ade.cs F0_1ade_0421 checks it). civ1-world and core-world move from devDependencies to dependencies for the terrain check.
